reading.body:
Equinix NY7 in North Bergen is a 71,946 square foot facility in New Jersey's Hudson County, part of Equinix's ten-building New York metro campus. The operator publishes no power capacity for this building, making its scale for AI workloads impossible to assess from available data. It maintains N+2 cooling redundancy, qualifying it for fault-tolerant hosted infrastructure, though this specification alone does not indicate whether the facility is sized or priced for AI training clusters.

New Jersey has 48 mapped data center facilities and only five with published power capacity totaling 111.3 megawatts, concentrated among a small number of operators. NY7 does not appear in the five published figures, placing it outside the state's disclosed capacity leaders despite its location in one of North America's densest infrastructure corridors.

Without published power capacity from Equinix, NY7 cannot be ranked against peers for AI infrastructure relevance. The absence of a disclosed megawatt figure across most regional facilities means this site's actual constraint on the grid, and therefore on AI scaling, remains unknown from public sources.
